limitations: Focused gates overlap with the full regression by design; their counts are independent release receipts, not additional unique tests.
Exact-pin schema and database fixtures validate committed contracts but do not execute a live consumer database.
The local unpublished biominer package cannot be resolved by the public vulnerability service and was skipped by pip-audit.
Secret scanning is heuristic; all findings and the zero-match high-confidence prefix scan remain explicit.
User-owned untracked runtime artifacts were preserved and excluded from the tracked release scope.
